fr.title: La compression des postes de débutant : pourquoi les jeunes diplômés ont du mal à décrocher un premier emploi alors que les employeurs s'appuient sur l'IA

segments.src: For decades, a college degree worked like a dependable ticket into the workforce.
segments.tr: Pendant des décennies, un diplôme universitaire a fonctionné comme un billet fiable pour entrer sur le marché du travail.

segments.src: Graduate in May, start a job by fall.
segments.tr: Diplômé en mai, commencer un emploi à l'automne.

segments.src: That pattern is looking less certain.
segments.tr: Ce schéma semble moins certain.

segments.src: Over the past couple of years, unemployment among recent college graduates has climbed above the overall national rate, a reversal of the long-standing norm in which degree holders fared better than the average worker.
segments.tr: Au cours des dernières années, le chômage chez les jeunes diplômés universitaires a grimpé au-dessus du taux national global, une inversion de la norme de longue date selon laquelle les diplômés s'en sortaient mieux que le travailleur moyen.

segments.src: At the same time, employers are openly rethinking what a "junior" role should look like as artificial intelligence tools take over many routine tasks.
segments.tr: Dans le même temps, les employeurs repensent ouvertement à quoi devrait ressembler un rôle "junior" alors que les outils d'intelligence artificielle prennent en charge de nombreuses tâches de routine.

segments.src: This article walks through what the data suggests, which fields appear most exposed, and what it could mean for the next generation of workers.
segments.tr: Cet article passe en revue ce que suggèrent les données, quels domaines semblent les plus exposés et ce que cela pourrait signifier pour la prochaine génération de travailleurs.

segments.src: It is a general overview, not career or financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'un aperçu général, et non de conseils de carrière ou financiers.

segments.src: ## What the Numbers Show
segments.tr: ## Ce que montrent les chiffres

segments.src: Federal Reserve Bank of New York research and U.S.
segments.tr: La recherche de la Réserve fédérale de New York et les données du

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics data have both pointed to the same trend: young, college-educated workers are having a harder time finding work than in the recent past.
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics ont toutes deux pointé vers la même tendance : les jeunes travailleurs diplômés de l'université ont plus de mal à trouver du travail que par le passé récent.

segments.src: In several recent readings, the unemployment rate for recent graduates (typically ages 22 to 27) has been higher than the rate for all workers.
segments.tr: Au cours de plusieurs lectures récentes, le taux de chômage des jeunes diplômés (généralement âgés de 22 à 27 ans) a été supérieur au taux pour l'ensemble des travailleurs.

segments.src: Historically, that gap ran the other way.
segments.tr: Historiquement, cet écart allait dans l'autre sens.

segments.src: A few details are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Quelques détails méritent d'être gardés à l'esprit :

segments.src: - **The gap is relative, not catastrophic.** Most recent graduates do find work. But the time it takes, and the share who end up in jobs that do not require a degree, have both drawn attention.
segments.tr: - **L'écart est relatif, pas catastrophique.** La plupart des jeunes diplômés trouvent un emploi. Mais le temps que cela prend, et la proportion qui finit par occuper des emplois ne nécessitant pas de diplôme, ont tous deux attiré l'attention.

segments.src: - **Underemployment matters too.** Many graduates take roles below their qualifications while they keep searching, which headline unemployment figures do not capture.
segments.tr: - **Le sous-emploi compte également.** De nombreux diplômés acceptent des rôles inférieurs à leurs qualifications tout en poursuivant leur recherche, ce que les chiffres globaux du chômage ne capturent pas.

segments.src: - **Several forces overlap.** Higher interest rates, cautious corporate hiring, a large number of graduates, and post-pandemic adjustments have all played a part. AI is one factor among several, and economists disagree about how large its role is so far.
segments.tr: - **Plusieurs forces se chevauchent.** Des taux d'intérêt plus élevés, des embauches d'entreprises prudentes, un grand nombre de diplômés et des ajustements post-pandémie ont tous joué un rôle. L'IA est un facteur parmi plusieurs, et les économistes ne sont pas d'accord sur l'importance de son rôle jusqu'à présent.

segments.src: ## Why Junior Roles Are Under Pressure
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les rôles juniors sont sous pression

segments.src: Entry-level jobs have traditionally served two purposes: getting basic work done and training the next generation of experienced staff.
segments.tr: Les emplois de premier niveau ont traditionnellement servi deux objectifs : accomplir le travail de base et former la prochaine génération de personnel expérimenté.

segments.src: Much of that basic work consists of tasks such as drafting summaries, cleaning up data, writing first-pass code, researching background material, and preparing routine reports.
segments.tr: Une grande partie de ce travail de base consiste en des tâches telles que la rédaction de résumés, le nettoyage de données, l'écriture de code de première passe, la recherche de matériel de référence et la préparation de rapports de routine.

segments.src: Those are the kinds of tasks that modern AI tools handle reasonably well.
segments.tr: Ce sont le genre de tâches que les outils d'IA modernes gèrent assez bien.

segments.src: Some hiring managers say they can now accomplish with a smaller team, or with a few experienced people using AI assistants, what once required a larger group that included several new hires.
segments.tr: Certains responsables du recrutement affirment qu'ils peuvent désormais accomplir avec une équipe plus restreinte, ou avec quelques personnes expérimentées utilisant des assistants IA, ce qui nécessitait autrefois un groupe plus important comprenant plusieurs nouvelles embauches.

segments.src: Others say they are simply being more selective, hiring fewer juniors and expecting those they do hire to arrive with stronger practical skills.
segments.tr: D'autres affirment qu'ils sont simplement plus sélectifs, embauchant moins de juniors et s'attendant à ce que ceux qu'ils embauchent arrivent avec de meilleures compétences pratiques.

segments.src: There is a caveat.
segments.tr: Il y a un bémol.

segments.src: Surveys of employers show mixed intentions, and some companies say they are still hiring beginners, or even expanding programs for them.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes auprès des employeurs montrent des intentions mitigées, et certaines entreprises affirment qu'elles embauchent toujours des débutants, ou même qu'elles élargissent les programmes pour eux.

segments.src: It is also hard to separate AI-driven change from the ordinary hiring cycle, in which companies pull back when the economy looks uncertain.
segments.tr: Il est également difficile de séparer le changement induit par l'IA du cycle de recrutement ordinaire, dans lequel les entreprises se retiraient lorsque l'économie semblait incertaine.

segments.src: ## Which Fields Appear Hardest Hit
segments.tr: ## Quels domaines semblent les plus touchés

segments.src: Researchers and labor analysts have noted that exposure varies widely by field.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs et les analystes du travail ont noté que l'exposition varie considérablement selon le domaine.

segments.src: - **Software and tech support.** Computer science graduates, once seen as nearly guaranteed a strong job market, have faced a tougher environment as companies trimmed headcount and AI coding assistants became common.
segments.tr: - **Logiciels et support technique.** Les diplômés en informatique, autrefois considérés comme ayant presque la garantie d'un marché du travail solide, ont fait face à un environnement plus difficile alors que les entreprises réduisaient leurs effectifs et que les assistants de codage IA devenaient courants.

segments.src: - **Marketing, content and communications.** Entry-level writing, editing and basic design work are areas where generative tools are widely used.
segments.tr: - **Marketing, contenu et communications.** L'écriture de premier niveau, l'édition et le travail de conception de base sont des domaines où les outils génératifs sont largement utilisés.

segments.src: - **Administrative and customer support roles.** Routine inquiries and scheduling are increasingly automated.
segments.tr: - **Rôles administratifs et de support client.** Les demandes de renseignements de routine et la planification sont de plus en plus automatisées.

segments.src: - **Finance and accounting support.** Data entry, reconciliation and first-pass analysis are being streamlined.
segments.tr: - **Support financier et comptable.** La saisie de données, le rapprochement et l'analyse de première passe sont rationalisés.

segments.src: - **Paralegal and research work.** Document review and summarization are common AI use cases.
segments.tr: - **Travail de paralégal et de recherche.** L'examen de documents et la synthèse sont des cas d'utilisation courants de l'IA.

segments.src: By contrast, fields that rely on hands-on, in-person or credential-gated work, such as nursing and other healthcare roles, skilled trades, and education, have generally seen steadier demand.
segments.tr: En revanche, les domaines qui reposent sur un travail pratique, en personne ou soumis à des diplômes, tels que les soins infirmiers et autres rôles de santé, les métiers qualifiés et l'éducation, ont généralement connu une demande plus stable.

segments.src: That does not mean they are risk-free, but the pressure looks different.
segments.tr: Cela ne signifie pas qu'ils sont sans risque, mais la pression semble différente.

segments.src: ## The Longer-Term Worry: A Broken Ladder
segments.tr: ## L'inquiétude à long terme : une échelle brisée

segments.src: The biggest concern among economists is not only whether this year's graduates find jobs.
segments.tr: La plus grande préoccupation des économistes n'est pas seulement de savoir si les diplômés de cette année trouvent un emploi.

segments.src: It is what happens if fewer entry-level positions exist over several years.
segments.tr: C'est ce qui se passe si moins de postes de débutant existent sur plusieurs années.

segments.src: Experienced professionals are developed by doing junior work first.
segments.tr: Les professionnels expérimentés se développent en faisant d'abord du travail junior.

segments.src: If that rung of the ladder shrinks, companies may face a shortage of mid-level talent later on, and workers may find it harder to build the experience that employers want.
segments.tr: Si ce barreau de l'échelle diminue, les entreprises pourraient faire face à une pénurie de talents de niveau intermédiaire plus tard, et les travailleurs pourraient avoir plus de mal à acquérir l'expérience que les employeurs recherchent.

segments.src: Some employers are already experimenting with responses, such as apprenticeships, rotational programs, and redesigned junior roles that focus on judgment, client contact and supervising AI output rather than producing every first draft by hand.
segments.tr: Certains employeurs expérimentent déjà des réponses, telles que des apprentissages, des programmes de rotation et des rôles juniors redessinés qui se concentrent sur le jugement, le contact avec les clients et la supervision de la sortie de l'IA plutôt que de produire chaque premier brouillon à la main.

segments.src: ## What Graduates Can Do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les diplômés peuvent faire

segments.src: There is no guaranteed formula, but career counselors and labor experts commonly suggest several practical steps:
segments.tr: Il n'y a pas de formule garantie, mais les conseillers d'orientation et les experts du travail suggèrent généralement plusieurs étapes pratiques :

segments.src: 1. **Build demonstrable skills.** Internships, co-ops, freelance projects and portfolios give employers evidence beyond a transcript.
segments.tr: 1. **Développer des compétences démontrables.** Les stages, les programmes coopératifs, les projets en freelance et les portfolios donnent aux employeurs des preuves au-delà d'un relevé de notes.

segments.src: 2. **Learn to work with AI tools.** Showing that you can use them well, check their output and catch their errors is increasingly seen as a baseline expectation.
segments.tr: 2. **Apprendre à travailler avec les outils d'IA.** Montrer que vous pouvez bien les utiliser, vérifier leurs résultats et repérer leurs erreurs est de plus en plus considéré comme une attente de base.

segments.src: 3. **Develop human-centered strengths.** Communication, collaboration, problem framing and persuasion remain hard to automate.
segments.tr: 3. **Développer des points forts centrés sur l'humain.** La communication, la collaboration, le cadrage de problèmes et la persuasion restent difficiles à automatiser.

segments.src: 4. **Widen the search.** Smaller firms, public-sector roles, nonprofits and industries outside your major may be more open to beginners.
segments.tr: 4. **Élargir la recherche.** Les petites entreprises, les rôles du secteur public, les organisations à but non lucratif et les industries en dehors de votre spécialisation peuvent être plus ouverts aux débutants.

segments.src: 5. **Use your network.** Referrals still account for a meaningful share of hires, especially when applicant volumes are high.
segments.tr: 5. **Utiliser votre réseau.** Les recommandations représentent toujours une part significative des embauches, en particulier lorsque les volumes de candidats sont élevés.

segments.src: 6. **Stay flexible.** A first job rarely defines an entire career, and many people move across fields within a few years.
segments.tr: 6. **Rester flexible.** Un premier emploi définit rarement toute une carrière, et beaucoup de gens changent de domaine en quelques années.

segments.src: ## What Policymakers and Schools Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Ce que pèsent les décideurs politiques et les écoles

segments.src: Universities are reviewing how well their programs match employer needs, and many are adding AI literacy to their curricula.
segments.tr: Les universités examinent dans quelle mesure leurs programmes correspondent aux besoins des employeurs, et beaucoup ajoutent l'alphabétisation à l'IA dans leurs programmes.

segments.src: Policymakers and workforce groups are discussing support for apprenticeships, retraining programs and clearer labor-market data so students can make better-informed choices.
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques et les groupes de main-d'œuvre discutent du soutien aux apprentissages, aux programmes de reconversion et à des données de marché du travail plus claires afin que les étudiants puissent faire des choix plus éclairés.

segments.src: Whether those efforts will keep pace with the technology remains an open question.
segments.tr: La question de savoir si ces efforts suivront le rythme de la technologie reste ouverte.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The data points to a genuinely harder market for new graduates than they have seen in years, with AI changing how employers think about beginner roles.
segments.tr: Les données indiquent un marché véritablement plus difficile pour les nouveaux diplômés qu'ils n'en ont vu depuis des années, l'IA modifiant la façon dont les employeurs perçoivent les rôles de débutants.

segments.src: Yet the picture is still developing.
segments.tr: Pourtant, le tableau est encore en train d'évoluer.

segments.src: Economists caution against drawing sweeping conclusions from a few years of numbers, and the hiring cycle could shift again.
segments.tr: Les économistes mettent en garde contre le fait de tirer des conclusions hâtives de quelques années de chiffres, et le cycle d'embauche pourrait changer à nouveau.

segments.src: For now, the most reliable advice is to build real-world experience, stay adaptable, and treat AI as a tool to master rather than only a threat.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, le conseil le plus fiable est d'acquérir une expérience du monde réel, de rester adaptable et de traiter l'IA comme un outil à maîtriser plutôt que comme une simple menace.

segments.src: Some employers are already experimenting with responses, such as apprenticeships, rotational programs, and redesigned junior roles that focus on judgment, client contact and supervising AI output rather than producing every first draft by hand.
segments.tr: Alguns empregadores já estão experimentando respostas, como estágios, programas de rotação e funções júnior redesenhadas que focam em julgamento, contato com o cliente e supervisão da produção da IA, em vez de produzir cada primeiro rascunho manualmente.

segments.src: ## What Graduates Can Do
segments.tr: ## O que os Graduados Podem Fazer

segments.src: There is no guaranteed formula, but career counselors and labor experts commonly suggest several practical steps:
segments.tr: Não há fórmula garantida, mas conselheiros de carreira e especialistas em trabalho sugerem comumente vários passos práticos:

segments.src: 1. **Build demonstrable skills.** Internships, co-ops, freelance projects and portfolios give employers evidence beyond a transcript.
segments.tr: 1. **Construa habilidades demonstráveis.** Estágios, co-ops, projetos freelance e portfólios dão aos empregadores evidências além de um histórico escolar.

segments.src: 2. **Learn to work with AI tools.** Showing that you can use them well, check their output and catch their errors is increasingly seen as a baseline expectation.
segments.tr: 2. **Aprenda a trabalhar com ferramentas de IA.** Mostrar que você pode usá-las bem, verificar sua produção e detectar seus erros é cada vez mais visto como uma expectativa básica.

segments.src: 3. **Develop human-centered strengths.** Communication, collaboration, problem framing and persuasion remain hard to automate.
segments.tr: 3. **Desenvolva pontos fortes centrados no ser humano.** Comunicação, colaboração, estruturação de problemas e persuasão continuam sendo difíceis de automatizar.

segments.src: 4. **Widen the search.** Smaller firms, public-sector roles, nonprofits and industries outside your major may be more open to beginners.
segments.tr: 4. **Amplie a busca.** Empresas menores, funções no setor público, organizações sem fins lucrativos e indústrias fora da sua área de formação podem estar mais abertas a iniciantes.

segments.src: 5. **Use your network.** Referrals still account for a meaningful share of hires, especially when applicant volumes are high.
segments.tr: 5. **Use sua rede.** Indicações ainda representam uma parcela significativa das contratações, especialmente quando os volumes de candidatos são altos.

segments.src: 6. **Stay flexible.** A first job rarely defines an entire career, and many people move across fields within a few years.
segments.tr: 6. **Mantenha-se flexível.** Um primeiro emprego raramente define uma carreira inteira, e muitas pessoas mudam de área dentro de alguns anos.

segments.src: ## What Policymakers and Schools Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## O que os Formuladores de Políticas e Escolas Estão Avaliando

segments.src: Universities are reviewing how well their programs match employer needs, and many are adding AI literacy to their curricula.
segments.tr: As universidades estão revisando o quão bem seus programas correspondem às necessidades dos empregadores, e muitas estão adicionando alfabetização em IA aos seus currículos.

segments.src: Policymakers and workforce groups are discussing support for apprenticeships, retraining programs and clearer labor-market data so students can make better-informed choices.
segments.tr: Formuladores de políticas e grupos de força de trabalho estão discutindo apoio a estágios, programas de requalificação e dados de mercado de trabalho mais claros para que os alunos possam fazer escolhas mais informadas.

segments.src: Whether those efforts will keep pace with the technology remains an open question.
segments.tr: Se esses esforços acompanharão a tecnologia continua sendo uma questão em aberto.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The data points to a genuinely harder market for new graduates than they have seen in years, with AI changing how employers think about beginner roles.
segments.tr: Os dados apontam para um mercado genuinamente mais difícil para novos graduados do que eles viram em anos, com a IA mudando a forma como os empregadores pensam sobre funções de iniciantes.

segments.src: Yet the picture is still developing.

in.title: Tekanan Tingkat Awal: Mengapa Lulusan Baru Kesulitan Mendapatkan Pekerjaan Pertama Saat Perusahaan Mengandalkan AI

segments.src: For decades, a college degree worked like a dependable ticket into the workforce.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa dekade, gelar sarjana berfungsi seperti tiket yang dapat diandalkan untuk masuk ke dunia kerja.

segments.src: Graduate in May, start a job by fall.
segments.tr: Lulus di bulan Mei, mulai bekerja di musim gugur.

segments.src: That pattern is looking less certain.
segments.tr: Pola itu kini terlihat kurang pasti.

segments.src: Over the past couple of years, unemployment among recent college graduates has climbed above the overall national rate, a reversal of the long-standing norm in which degree holders fared better than the average worker.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa tahun terakhir, pengangguran di kalangan lulusan baru perguruan tinggi telah naik di atas tingkat nasional secara keseluruhan, sebuah pembalikan dari norma lama di mana pemegang gelar bernasib lebih baik daripada rata-rata pekerja.

segments.src: At the same time, employers are openly rethinking what a "junior" role should look like as artificial intelligence tools take over many routine tasks.
segments.tr: Pada saat yang sama, pemberi kerja secara terbuka memikirkan kembali seperti apa peran "junior" seharusnya seiring dengan alat kecerdasan buatan (AI) yang mengambil alih banyak tugas rutin.

segments.src: This article walks through what the data suggests, which fields appear most exposed, and what it could mean for the next generation of workers.
segments.tr: Artikel ini membahas apa yang disarankan oleh data, bidang mana yang tampak paling terpapar, dan apa artinya bagi generasi pekerja berikutnya.

segments.src: It is a general overview, not career or financial advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah gambaran umum, bukan saran karier atau keuangan.

segments.src: ## What the Numbers Show
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Ditunjukkan oleh Angka

segments.src: Federal Reserve Bank of New York research and U.S.
segments.tr: Penelitian Federal Reserve Bank of New York dan data U.S.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics data have both pointed to the same trend: young, college-educated workers are having a harder time finding work than in the recent past.
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics keduanya menunjukkan tren yang sama: pekerja muda berpendidikan tinggi mengalami kesulitan mencari pekerjaan dibandingkan masa lalu.

segments.src: In several recent readings, the unemployment rate for recent graduates (typically ages 22 to 27) has been higher than the rate for all workers.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa pembacaan terbaru, tingkat pengangguran untuk lulusan baru (biasanya usia 22 hingga 27 tahun) lebih tinggi daripada tingkat untuk semua pekerja.

segments.src: Historically, that gap ran the other way.
segments.tr: Secara historis, kesenjangan itu berjalan sebaliknya.

segments.src: A few details are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Beberapa detail perlu diingat:

segments.src: - **The gap is relative, not catastrophic.** Most recent graduates do find work. But the time it takes, and the share who end up in jobs that do not require a degree, have both drawn attention.
segments.tr: - **Kesenjangan ini bersifat relatif, bukan bencana.** Sebagian besar lulusan baru memang mendapatkan pekerjaan. Namun, waktu yang dibutuhkan, dan bagian yang akhirnya bekerja di pekerjaan yang tidak memerlukan gelar, keduanya telah menarik perhatian.

segments.src: - **Underemployment matters too.** Many graduates take roles below their qualifications while they keep searching, which headline unemployment figures do not capture.
segments.tr: - **Setengah pengangguran (underemployment) juga penting.** Banyak lulusan mengambil peran di bawah kualifikasi mereka sambil terus mencari, yang tidak ditangkap oleh angka pengangguran utama.

segments.src: - **Several forces overlap.** Higher interest rates, cautious corporate hiring, a large number of graduates, and post-pandemic adjustments have all played a part. AI is one factor among several, and economists disagree about how large its role is so far.
segments.tr: - **Beberapa kekuatan tumpang tindih.** Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi, perekrutan perusahaan yang berhati-hati, sejumlah besar lulusan, dan penyesuaian pascapandemi semuanya berperan. AI adalah salah satu faktor di antara beberapa faktor lainnya, dan para ekonom tidak setuju tentang seberapa besar perannya sejauh ini.

segments.src: ## Why Junior Roles Are Under Pressure
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Peran Junior Berada di Bawah Tekanan

segments.src: Entry-level jobs have traditionally served two purposes: getting basic work done and training the next generation of experienced staff.
segments.tr: Pekerjaan tingkat awal secara tradisional memiliki dua tujuan: menyelesaikan pekerjaan dasar dan melatih generasi staf berpengalaman berikutnya.

segments.src: Much of that basic work consists of tasks such as drafting summaries, cleaning up data, writing first-pass code, researching background material, and preparing routine reports.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar pekerjaan dasar itu terdiri dari tugas-tugas seperti menyusun ringkasan, membersihkan data, menulis kode tahap pertama, meneliti materi latar belakang, dan menyiapkan laporan rutin.

segments.src: Those are the kinds of tasks that modern AI tools handle reasonably well.
segments.tr: Itu adalah jenis tugas yang ditangani dengan cukup baik oleh alat AI modern.

segments.src: Some hiring managers say they can now accomplish with a smaller team, or with a few experienced people using AI assistants, what once required a larger group that included several new hires.
segments.tr: Beberapa manajer perekrutan mengatakan mereka sekarang dapat mencapai hasil dengan tim yang lebih kecil, atau dengan beberapa orang berpengalaman yang menggunakan asisten AI, yang dulunya memerlukan kelompok yang lebih besar yang mencakup beberapa karyawan baru.

segments.src: Others say they are simply being more selective, hiring fewer juniors and expecting those they do hire to arrive with stronger practical skills.
segments.tr: Yang lain mengatakan mereka hanya menjadi lebih selektif, mempekerjakan lebih sedikit junior dan mengharapkan mereka yang mereka pekerjakan untuk datang dengan keterampilan praktis yang lebih kuat.

segments.src: There is a caveat.
segments.tr: Ada peringatan.

segments.src: Surveys of employers show mixed intentions, and some companies say they are still hiring beginners, or even expanding programs for them.
segments.tr: Survei terhadap pemberi kerja menunjukkan niat yang beragam, dan beberapa perusahaan mengatakan mereka masih mempekerjakan pemula, atau bahkan memperluas program untuk mereka.

segments.src: It is also hard to separate AI-driven change from the ordinary hiring cycle, in which companies pull back when the economy looks uncertain.
segments.tr: Juga sulit untuk memisahkan perubahan yang didorong oleh AI dari siklus perekrutan biasa, di mana perusahaan menarik diri ketika ekonomi terlihat tidak pasti.

segments.src: ## Which Fields Appear Hardest Hit
segments.tr: ## Bidang Mana yang Tampak Paling Terpukul

segments.src: Researchers and labor analysts have noted that exposure varies widely by field.
segments.tr: Para peneliti dan analis tenaga kerja mencatat bahwa paparan sangat bervariasi menurut bidang.

segments.src: - **Software and tech support.** Computer science graduates, once seen as nearly guaranteed a strong job market, have faced a tougher environment as companies trimmed headcount and AI coding assistants became common.
segments.tr: - **Perangkat lunak dan dukungan teknis.** Lulusan ilmu komputer, yang dulunya dianggap hampir menjamin pasar kerja yang kuat, telah menghadapi lingkungan yang lebih sulit karena perusahaan memangkas jumlah karyawan dan asisten pengodean AI menjadi umum.

segments.src: - **Marketing, content and communications.** Entry-level writing, editing and basic design work are areas where generative tools are widely used.
segments.tr: - **Pemasaran, konten, dan komunikasi.** Penulisan tingkat awal, penyuntingan, dan pekerjaan desain dasar adalah area di mana alat generatif digunakan secara luas.

segments.src: - **Administrative and customer support roles.** Routine inquiries and scheduling are increasingly automated.
segments.tr: - **Peran administratif dan dukungan pelanggan.** Pertanyaan rutin dan penjadwalan semakin otomatis.

segments.src: - **Finance and accounting support.** Data entry, reconciliation and first-pass analysis are being streamlined.
segments.tr: - **Dukungan keuangan dan akuntansi.** Entri data, rekonsiliasi, dan analisis tahap pertama sedang disederhanakan.

segments.src: - **Paralegal and research work.** Document review and summarization are common AI use cases.
segments.tr: - **Pekerjaan paralegal dan penelitian.** Peninjauan dokumen dan peringkasan adalah kasus penggunaan AI yang umum.

segments.src: By contrast, fields that rely on hands-on, in-person or credential-gated work, such as nursing and other healthcare roles, skilled trades, and education, have generally seen steadier demand.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, bidang yang mengandalkan pekerjaan langsung, tatap muka, atau pekerjaan yang memerlukan kredensial, seperti keperawatan dan peran kesehatan lainnya, perdagangan terampil, dan pendidikan, umumnya melihat permintaan yang lebih stabil.

segments.src: That does not mean they are risk-free, but the pressure looks different.
segments.tr: Itu tidak berarti mereka bebas risiko, tetapi tekanannya terlihat berbeda.

segments.src: ## The Longer-Term Worry: A Broken Ladder
segments.tr: ## Kekhawatiran Jangka Panjang: Tangga yang Rusak

segments.src: The biggest concern among economists is not only whether this year's graduates find jobs.
segments.tr: Kekhawatiran terbesar di kalangan ekonom bukan hanya apakah lulusan tahun ini mendapatkan pekerjaan.

segments.src: It is what happens if fewer entry-level positions exist over several years.
segments.tr: Ini adalah apa yang terjadi jika lebih sedikit posisi tingkat awal yang ada selama beberapa tahun.

segments.src: Experienced professionals are developed by doing junior work first.
segments.tr: Profesional berpengalaman dikembangkan dengan melakukan pekerjaan junior terlebih dahulu.

segments.src: If that rung of the ladder shrinks, companies may face a shortage of mid-level talent later on, and workers may find it harder to build the experience that employers want.
segments.tr: Jika anak tangga itu menyusut, perusahaan mungkin menghadapi kekurangan talenta tingkat menengah di kemudian hari, dan pekerja mungkin merasa lebih sulit untuk membangun pengalaman yang diinginkan pemberi kerja.

segments.src: Some employers are already experimenting with responses, such as apprenticeships, rotational programs, and redesigned junior roles that focus on judgment, client contact and supervising AI output rather than producing every first draft by hand.
segments.tr: Beberapa pemberi kerja sudah bereksperimen dengan tanggapan, seperti magang, program rotasi, dan peran junior yang dirancang ulang yang berfokus pada penilaian, kontak klien, dan mengawasi output AI daripada memproduksi setiap draf pertama dengan tangan.

segments.src: ## What Graduates Can Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Bisa Dilakukan Lulusan

segments.src: There is no guaranteed formula, but career counselors and labor experts commonly suggest several practical steps:
segments.tr: Tidak ada formula yang dijamin, tetapi konselor karier dan pakar tenaga kerja biasanya menyarankan beberapa langkah praktis:

segments.src: 1. **Build demonstrable skills.** Internships, co-ops, freelance projects and portfolios give employers evidence beyond a transcript.
segments.tr: 1. **Bangun keterampilan yang dapat dibuktikan.** Magang, ko-op, proyek lepas, dan portofolio memberi pemberi kerja bukti di luar transkrip.

segments.src: 2. **Learn to work with AI tools.** Showing that you can use them well, check their output and catch their errors is increasingly seen as a baseline expectation.
segments.tr: 2. **Belajar bekerja dengan alat AI.** Menunjukkan bahwa Anda dapat menggunakannya dengan baik, memeriksa outputnya, dan menangkap kesalahannya semakin dipandang sebagai ekspektasi dasar.

segments.src: 3. **Develop human-centered strengths.** Communication, collaboration, problem framing and persuasion remain hard to automate.
segments.tr: 3. **Kembangkan kekuatan yang berpusat pada manusia.** Komunikasi, kolaborasi, pembingkaian masalah, dan persuasi tetap sulit untuk diotomatisasi.

segments.src: 4. **Widen the search.** Smaller firms, public-sector roles, nonprofits and industries outside your major may be more open to beginners.
segments.tr: 4. **Perluas pencarian.** Perusahaan yang lebih kecil, peran sektor publik, organisasi nirlaba, dan industri di luar jurusan Anda mungkin lebih terbuka untuk pemula.

segments.src: 5. **Use your network.** Referrals still account for a meaningful share of hires, especially when applicant volumes are high.
segments.tr: 5. **Gunakan jaringan Anda.** Referensi masih menyumbang bagian yang berarti dari perekrutan, terutama ketika volume pelamar tinggi.

segments.src: 6. **Stay flexible.** A first job rarely defines an entire career, and many people move across fields within a few years.
segments.tr: 6. **Tetap fleksibel.** Pekerjaan pertama jarang menentukan seluruh karier, dan banyak orang berpindah bidang dalam beberapa tahun.

segments.src: ## What Policymakers and Schools Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dipertimbangkan oleh Pembuat Kebijakan dan Sekolah

segments.src: Universities are reviewing how well their programs match employer needs, and many are adding AI literacy to their curricula.
segments.tr: Universitas sedang meninjau seberapa baik program mereka sesuai dengan kebutuhan pemberi kerja, dan banyak yang menambahkan literasi AI ke dalam kurikulum mereka.

segments.src: Policymakers and workforce groups are discussing support for apprenticeships, retraining programs and clearer labor-market data so students can make better-informed choices.
segments.tr: Pembuat kebijakan dan kelompok tenaga kerja sedang mendiskusikan dukungan untuk magang, program pelatihan ulang, dan data pasar tenaga kerja yang lebih jelas sehingga siswa dapat membuat pilihan yang lebih tepat.

segments.src: Whether those efforts will keep pace with the technology remains an open question.
segments.tr: Apakah upaya tersebut akan mengimbangi teknologi tetap menjadi pertanyaan terbuka.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The data points to a genuinely harder market for new graduates than they have seen in years, with AI changing how employers think about beginner roles.
segments.tr: Data menunjukkan pasar yang benar-benar lebih sulit bagi lulusan baru daripada yang mereka lihat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, dengan AI mengubah cara pemberi kerja berpikir tentang peran pemula.

segments.src: Yet the picture is still developing.
segments.tr: Namun gambaran tersebut masih berkembang.

segments.src: Economists caution against drawing sweeping conclusions from a few years of numbers, and the hiring cycle could shift again.
segments.tr: Para ekonom memperingatkan agar tidak menarik kesimpulan menyeluruh dari angka beberapa tahun, dan siklus perekrutan bisa berubah lagi.

segments.src: For now, the most reliable advice is to build real-world experience, stay adaptable, and treat AI as a tool to master rather than only a threat.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, saran yang paling dapat diandalkan adalah membangun pengalaman dunia nyata, tetap mudah beradaptasi, dan memperlakukan AI sebagai alat untuk dikuasai daripada hanya sebagai ancaman.

segments.src: ## Why Junior Roles Are Under Pressure
segments.tr: ## なぜジュニア職が圧迫されているのか

segments.src: Entry-level jobs have traditionally served two purposes: getting basic work done and training the next generation of experienced staff.
segments.tr: エントリーレベルの仕事は伝統的に、基本的な業務をこなすことと、経験豊富な次世代のスタッフを育成するという2つの目的を果たしてきました。

segments.src: Much of that basic work consists of tasks such as drafting summaries, cleaning up data, writing first-pass code, researching background material, and preparing routine reports.
segments.tr: そうした基本的な業務の多くは、要約の作成、データの整理、最初のコードの記述、背景資料の調査、日常的なレポートの準備といったタスクで構成されています。

segments.src: Those are the kinds of tasks that modern AI tools handle reasonably well.
segments.tr: これらは、現代のAIツールがかなりうまくこなせる種類のタスクです。

segments.src: Some hiring managers say they can now accomplish with a smaller team, or with a few experienced people using AI assistants, what once required a larger group that included several new hires.
segments.tr: 一部の採用担当者は、かつては数人の新人を加えた大きなチームが必要だった業務を、今ではAIアシスタントを活用する少人数の経験者チームでこなせると述べています。

segments.src: Others say they are simply being more selective, hiring fewer juniors and expecting those they do hire to arrive with stronger practical skills.
segments.tr: また、単により選別的になり、採用するジュニアの数を減らし、採用する人材にはより強力な実践的スキルを求めているという声もあります。

segments.src: There is a caveat.
segments.tr: ただし、注意点もあります。

segments.src: Surveys of employers show mixed intentions, and some companies say they are still hiring beginners, or even expanding programs for them.
segments.tr: 雇用主への調査では意図が分かれており、依然として初心者の採用を続けている、あるいは初心者向けのプログラムを拡大していると答える企業もあります。

segments.src: It is also hard to separate AI-driven change from the ordinary hiring cycle, in which companies pull back when the economy looks uncertain.
segments.tr: また、AI主導の変化と、経済が不透明な時に企業が採用を控える通常の採用サイクルを切り離して考えるのは困難です。

segments.src: ## Which Fields Appear Hardest Hit
segments.tr: ## どの分野が最も打撃を受けているか

segments.src: Researchers and labor analysts have noted that exposure varies widely by field.
segments.tr: 研究者や労働アナリストは、影響の受けやすさは分野によって大きく異なると指摘しています。

segments.src: - **Software and tech support.** Computer science graduates, once seen as nearly guaranteed a strong job market, have faced a tougher environment as companies trimmed headcount and AI coding assistants became common.
segments.tr: - **ソフトウェアおよび技術サポート。** かつては強力な雇用市場がほぼ保証されていると見なされていたコンピュータサイエンスの卒業生も、企業が人員を削減し、AIコーディングアシスタントが普及するにつれて、より厳しい環境に直面しています。

segments.src: - **Marketing, content and communications.** Entry-level writing, editing and basic design work are areas where generative tools are widely used.
segments.tr: - **マーケティング、コンテンツ、コミュニケーション。** エントリーレベルのライティング、編集、基本的なデザイン作業は、生成AIツールが広く使われている分野です。

segments.src: - **Administrative and customer support roles.** Routine inquiries and scheduling are increasingly automated.
segments.tr: - **事務およびカスタマーサポート職。** 定型的な問い合わせやスケジューリングは、ますます自動化されています。

segments.src: - **Finance and accounting support.** Data entry, reconciliation and first-pass analysis are being streamlined.
segments.tr: - **財務および会計サポート。** データ入力、照合、最初の分析作業は効率化が進んでいます。

segments.src: - **Paralegal and research work.** Document review and summarization are common AI use cases.
segments.tr: - **パラリーガルおよび調査業務。** 文書のレビューや要約は、一般的なAIの活用事例です。

segments.src: By contrast, fields that rely on hands-on, in-person or credential-gated work, such as nursing and other healthcare roles, skilled trades, and education, have generally seen steadier demand.
segments.tr: 対照的に、看護やその他の医療職、熟練技能職、教育など、実践的で対面での対応や資格が必要な仕事に依存する分野では、概して需要が安定しています。

segments.src: That does not mean they are risk-free, but the pressure looks different.
segments.tr: だからといってリスクがないわけではありませんが、受けている圧力の性質が異なります。

segments.src: ## The Longer-Term Worry: A Broken Ladder
segments.tr: ## 長期的な懸念：壊れた梯子

segments.src: The biggest concern among economists is not only whether this year's graduates find jobs.
segments.tr: 経済学者の間での最大の懸念は、今年の卒業生が就職できるかどうかだけではありません。

segments.src: It is what happens if fewer entry-level positions exist over several years.
segments.tr: 数年にわたってエントリーレベルのポジションが減少した場合、何が起こるかということです。

segments.src: Experienced professionals are developed by doing junior work first.
segments.tr: 経験豊富な専門家は、まずジュニアレベルの仕事をこなすことで育成されます。

segments.src: If that rung of the ladder shrinks, companies may face a shortage of mid-level talent later on, and workers may find it harder to build the experience that employers want.
segments.tr: もしその梯子の段が縮小すれば、企業は将来的に中堅レベルの人材不足に直面する可能性があり、労働者は雇用主が求める経験を積むことが難しくなるかもしれません。

segments.src: Some employers are already experimenting with responses, such as apprenticeships, rotational programs, and redesigned junior roles that focus on judgment, client contact and supervising AI output rather than producing every first draft by hand.
segments.tr: 一部の雇用主はすでに対応策を試みています。例えば、見習い制度、ローテーションプログラム、そしてすべての初稿を手作業で作成するのではなく、判断力、クライアントとの接触、AIの成果物の監督に重点を置いた、再設計されたジュニア職などです。

segments.src: ## What Graduates Can Do
segments.tr: ## 卒業生ができること

segments.src: There is no guaranteed formula, but career counselors and labor experts commonly suggest several practical steps:
segments.tr: 保証された公式はありませんが、キャリアカウンセラーや労働専門家は、いくつかの実践的なステップを提案しています。

segments.src: 1. **Build demonstrable skills.** Internships, co-ops, freelance projects and portfolios give employers evidence beyond a transcript.
segments.tr: 1. **証明可能なスキルを構築する。** インターンシップ、コーオプ（就業体験）、フリーランスのプロジェクト、ポートフォリオは、成績証明書以上の証拠を雇用主に提供します。

segments.src: 2. **Learn to work with AI tools.** Showing that you can use them well, check their output and catch their errors is increasingly seen as a baseline expectation.
segments.tr: 2. **AIツールの使い方を学ぶ。** AIをうまく使いこなし、その出力をチェックし、エラーを見つけられることを示すことは、ますます基本的な期待値と見なされるようになっています。

segments.src: 3. **Develop human-centered strengths.** Communication, collaboration, problem framing and persuasion remain hard to automate.
segments.tr: 3. **人間中心の強みを伸ばす。** コミュニケーション、コラボレーション、問題の枠組み作り、説得力は、依然として自動化が困難です。

segments.src: 4. **Widen the search.** Smaller firms, public-sector roles, nonprofits and industries outside your major may be more open to beginners.
segments.tr: 4. **検索範囲を広げる。** 小規模企業、公共部門の役割、非営利団体、専攻外の業界の方が、初心者に対してよりオープンである可能性があります。

segments.src: 5. **Use your network.** Referrals still account for a meaningful share of hires, especially when applicant volumes are high.
segments.tr: 5. **ネットワークを活用する。** 特に求職者が多い場合、紹介は依然として採用の重要な割合を占めています。

segments.src: 6. **Stay flexible.** A first job rarely defines an entire career, and many people move across fields within a few years.
segments.tr: 6. **柔軟性を保つ。** 最初の仕事がキャリア全体を決定づけることは稀であり、多くの人が数年以内に分野をまたいで移動しています。

segments.src: ## What Policymakers and Schools Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## 政策立案者と学校が検討していること

segments.src: Universities are reviewing how well their programs match employer needs, and many are adding AI literacy to their curricula.
segments.tr: 大学は、プログラムが雇用主のニーズにどれだけ適合しているかを再検討しており、多くの大学がカリキュラムにAIリテラシーを追加しています。

segments.src: Policymakers and workforce groups are discussing support for apprenticeships, retraining programs and clearer labor-market data so students can make better-informed choices.
segments.tr: 政策立案者や労働団体は、見習い制度への支援、再教育プログラム、そして学生がより十分な情報に基づいて選択できるようにするための、より明確な労働市場データについて議論しています。

segments.src: Whether those efforts will keep pace with the technology remains an open question.
segments.tr: これらの取り組みがテクノロジーの進化に追いつけるかどうかは、依然として未解決の問題です。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The data points to a genuinely harder market for new graduates than they have seen in years, with AI changing how employers think about beginner roles.
segments.tr: データは、新卒者にとってここ数年で最も厳しい市場であることを示しており、AIが雇用主の初心者に対する考え方を変えています。

segments.src: Yet the picture is still developing.
segments.tr: しかし、状況はまだ発展途上です。

segments.src: Economists caution against drawing sweeping conclusions from a few years of numbers, and the hiring cycle could shift again.
segments.tr: 経済学者は、数年間の数字から広範な結論を導き出すことには慎重であり、採用サイクルは再び変化する可能性があります。

segments.src: For now, the most reliable advice is to build real-world experience, stay adaptable, and treat AI as a tool to master rather than only a threat.
segments.tr: 今のところ、最も信頼できるアドバイスは、現実世界の経験を積み、適応力を維持し、AIを単なる脅威ではなく、習得すべきツールとして扱うことです。

segments.tr: 数値や傾向は時間の経過とともに変化します。最新のデータについては、労働統計局およびニューヨーク連邦準備銀行の最新の発表を参照してください。*

de.title: Der Druck auf Einsteigerpositionen: Warum Absolventen es schwer haben, einen ersten Job zu finden, während Arbeitgeber auf KI setzen

segments.src: For decades, a college degree worked like a dependable ticket into the workforce.
segments.tr: Jahrzehntelang funktionierte ein Hochschulabschluss wie ein verlässliches Ticket in die Arbeitswelt.

segments.src: Graduate in May, start a job by fall.
segments.tr: Im Mai den Abschluss machen, im Herbst den Job beginnen.

segments.src: That pattern is looking less certain.
segments.tr: Dieses Muster wirkt nun weniger sicher.

segments.src: Over the past couple of years, unemployment among recent college graduates has climbed above the overall national rate, a reversal of the long-standing norm in which degree holders fared better than the average worker.
segments.tr: In den letzten zwei Jahren ist die Arbeitslosigkeit unter Hochschulabsolventen über die nationale Gesamtrate gestiegen – eine Umkehrung der langjährigen Norm, bei der Abschlussinhaber besser abschnitten als der durchschnittliche Arbeitnehmer.

segments.src: At the same time, employers are openly rethinking what a "junior" role should look like as artificial intelligence tools take over many routine tasks.
segments.tr: Gleichzeitig überdenken Arbeitgeber offen, wie eine "Junior"-Rolle aussehen sollte, da Werkzeuge der künstlichen Intelligenz viele Routineaufgaben übernehmen.

segments.src: This article walks through what the data suggests, which fields appear most exposed, and what it could mean for the next generation of workers.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erläutert, was die Daten nahelegen, welche Bereiche am stärksten betroffen scheinen und was dies für die nächste Generation von Arbeitnehmern bedeuten könnte.

segments.src: It is a general overview, not career or financial advice.
segments.tr: Es handelt sich um einen allgemeinen Überblick, nicht um eine Karriere- oder Finanzberatung.

segments.src: ## What the Numbers Show
segments.tr: ## Was die Zahlen zeigen

segments.src: Federal Reserve Bank of New York research and U.S.
segments.tr: Forschungen der Federal Reserve Bank of New York und Daten des U.S.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics data have both pointed to the same trend: young, college-educated workers are having a harder time finding work than in the recent past.
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics deuten beide auf denselben Trend hin: Junge Arbeitnehmer mit Hochschulabschluss haben es schwerer, Arbeit zu finden, als in der jüngeren Vergangenheit.

segments.src: In several recent readings, the unemployment rate for recent graduates (typically ages 22 to 27) has been higher than the rate for all workers.
segments.tr: In mehreren jüngsten Erhebungen lag die Arbeitslosenquote für Berufseinsteiger (in der Regel im Alter von 22 bis 27 Jahren) höher als die Quote für alle Arbeitnehmer.

segments.src: Historically, that gap ran the other way.
segments.tr: Historisch gesehen verlief diese Lücke genau umgekehrt.

segments.src: A few details are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Einige Details sollte man dabei im Hinterkopf behalten:

segments.src: - **The gap is relative, not catastrophic.** Most recent graduates do find work. But the time it takes, and the share who end up in jobs that do not require a degree, have both drawn attention.
segments.tr: - **Die Lücke ist relativ, nicht katastrophal.** Die meisten Absolventen finden Arbeit. Aber die Zeit, die es dauert, und der Anteil derjenigen, die in Jobs landen, die keinen Abschluss erfordern, haben Aufmerksamkeit erregt.

segments.src: - **Underemployment matters too.** Many graduates take roles below their qualifications while they keep searching, which headline unemployment figures do not capture.
segments.tr: - **Unterbeschäftigung spielt ebenfalls eine Rolle.** Viele Absolventen nehmen Rollen unterhalb ihrer Qualifikation an, während sie weiter suchen, was von den Haupfeilern der Arbeitslosenstatistik nicht erfasst wird.

segments.src: - **Several forces overlap.** Higher interest rates, cautious corporate hiring, a large number of graduates, and post-pandemic adjustments have all played a part. AI is one factor among several, and economists disagree about how large its role is so far.
segments.tr: - **Mehrere Kräfte überschneiden sich.** Höhere Zinsen, vorsichtige Neueinstellungen in Unternehmen, eine hohe Zahl von Absolventen und Anpassungen nach der Pandemie haben alle eine Rolle gespielt. KI ist ein Faktor unter mehreren, und Ökonomen sind sich uneinig darüber, wie groß ihre Rolle bisher ist.

segments.src: ## Why Junior Roles Are Under Pressure
segments.tr: ## Warum Junior-Rollen unter Druck stehen

segments.src: Entry-level jobs have traditionally served two purposes: getting basic work done and training the next generation of experienced staff.
segments.tr: Einsteigerjobs dienten traditionell zwei Zwecken: die Erledigung grundlegender Arbeiten und die Ausbildung der nächsten Generation erfahrener Mitarbeiter.

segments.src: Much of that basic work consists of tasks such as drafting summaries, cleaning up data, writing first-pass code, researching background material, and preparing routine reports.
segments.tr: Ein Großteil dieser grundlegenden Arbeit besteht aus Aufgaben wie dem Erstellen von Zusammenfassungen, dem Bereinigen von Daten, dem Schreiben von Code in erster Fassung, der Recherche von Hintergrundmaterial und der Erstellung von Routineberichten.

segments.src: Those are the kinds of tasks that modern AI tools handle reasonably well.
segments.tr: Das sind genau die Arten von Aufgaben, die moderne KI-Tools passabel bewältigen.

segments.src: Some hiring managers say they can now accomplish with a smaller team, or with a few experienced people using AI assistants, what once required a larger group that included several new hires.
segments.tr: Einige Personalverantwortliche geben an, dass sie mit einem kleineren Team oder mit wenigen erfahrenen Personen, die KI-Assistenten nutzen, jetzt das erreichen können, was früher eine größere Gruppe mit mehreren Neueinsteigern erforderte.

segments.src: Others say they are simply being more selective, hiring fewer juniors and expecting those they do hire to arrive with stronger practical skills.
segments.tr: Andere sagen, dass sie einfach selektiver vorgehen, weniger Einsteiger einstellen und von den Eingestellten erwarten, dass sie bereits mit ausgeprägteren praktischen Fähigkeiten ankommen.

segments.src: There is a caveat.
segments.tr: Es gibt jedoch einen Vorbehalt.

segments.src: Surveys of employers show mixed intentions, and some companies say they are still hiring beginners, or even expanding programs for them.
segments.tr: Befragungen von Arbeitgebern zeigen gemischte Absichten, und einige Unternehmen geben an, dass sie weiterhin Anfänger einstellen oder sogar Programme für sie ausbauen.

segments.src: It is also hard to separate AI-driven change from the ordinary hiring cycle, in which companies pull back when the economy looks uncertain.
segments.tr: Es ist auch schwierig, KI-getriebene Veränderungen vom gewöhnlichen Einstellungsschluss zu trennen, bei dem Unternehmen zurückstecken, wenn die Wirtschaft unsicher erscheint.

segments.src: ## Which Fields Appear Hardest Hit
segments.tr: ## Welche Bereiche am stärksten betroffen scheinen

segments.src: Researchers and labor analysts have noted that exposure varies widely by field.
segments.tr: Forscher und Arbeitsmarktanalysten haben festgestellt, dass die Betroffenheit je nach Branche stark variiert.

segments.src: - **Software and tech support.** Computer science graduates, once seen as nearly guaranteed a strong job market, have faced a tougher environment as companies trimmed headcount and AI coding assistants became common.
segments.tr: - **Software und IT-Support.** Informatik-Absolventen, denen einst ein nahezu garantierter starker Arbeitsmarkt bevorstand, sahen sich mit einem schwierigeren Umfeld konfrontiert, da Unternehmen Personal abbauten und KI-Programmierassistenten üblich wurden.

segments.src: - **Marketing, content and communications.** Entry-level writing, editing and basic design work are areas where generative tools are widely used.
segments.tr: - **Marketing, Content und Kommunikation.** Einsteigerarbeiten im Bereich Schreiben, Lektorat und grundlegendes Design sind Bereiche, in denen generative Tools weit verbreitet eingesetzt werden.

segments.src: - **Administrative and customer support roles.** Routine inquiries and scheduling are increasingly automated.
segments.tr: - **Verwaltung und Kundenbetreuung.** Routineanfragen und Terminplanungen werden zunehmend automatisiert.

segments.src: - **Finance and accounting support.** Data entry, reconciliation and first-pass analysis are being streamlined.
segments.tr: - **Finanz- und Buchhaltungssupport.** Datenerfassung, Abstimmung und Erstanalysen werden rationalisiert.

segments.src: - **Paralegal and research work.** Document review and summarization are common AI use cases.
segments.tr: - **Anwaltsgehilfen und Recherchearbeit.** Dokumentenprüfung und Zusammenfassung sind gängige Anwendungsfälle für KI.

segments.src: By contrast, fields that rely on hands-on, in-person or credential-gated work, such as nursing and other healthcare roles, skilled trades, and education, have generally seen steadier demand.
segments.tr: Im Gegensatz dazu verzeichneten Bereiche, die auf praktische, persönliche oder an Qualifikationen gebundene Arbeit angewiesen sind – wie die Pflege und andere Gesundheitsberufe, das Handwerk und die Bildung – im Allgemeinen eine stabilere Nachfrage.

segments.src: That does not mean they are risk-free, but the pressure looks different.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet nicht, dass sie risikofrei sind, aber der Druck sieht anders aus.

segments.src: ## The Longer-Term Worry: A Broken Ladder
segments.tr: ## Die längerfristige Sorge: Eine zerbrochene Karriereleiter

segments.src: The biggest concern among economists is not only whether this year's graduates find jobs.
segments.tr: Die größte Sorge von Ökonomen ist nicht nur, ob die diesjährigen Absolventen Arbeit finden.

segments.src: It is what happens if fewer entry-level positions exist over several years.
segments.tr: Es ist die Frage, was passiert, wenn über mehrere Jahre hinweg weniger Einsteigerpositionen existieren.

segments.src: Experienced professionals are developed by doing junior work first.
segments.tr: Erfahrene Fachkräfte entwickeln sich, indem sie zuerst Junior-Arbeiten erledigen.

segments.src: If that rung of the ladder shrinks, companies may face a shortage of mid-level talent later on, and workers may find it harder to build the experience that employers want.
segments.tr: Wenn diese Sprosse der Leiter schrumpft, könnten Unternehmen später mit einem Mangel an Talenten auf mittlerer Ebene konfrontiert sein, und es könnte für Arbeitnehmer schwieriger werden, die von Arbeitgebern gewünschte Erfahrung aufzubauen.

segments.src: Some employers are already experimenting with responses, such as apprenticeships, rotational programs, and redesigned junior roles that focus on judgment, client contact and supervising AI output rather than producing every first draft by hand.
segments.tr: Einige Arbeitgeber experimentieren bereits mit Antworten darauf, wie z. B. Ausbildungsprogrammen, Rotationsprogrammen und neu gestalteten Junior-Rollen, die den Schwerpunkt auf Urteilsvermögen, Kundenkontakt und die Überwachung von KI-Ergebnissen legen, anstatt jeden ersten Entwurf von Hand zu erstellen.

segments.src: ## What Graduates Can Do
segments.tr: ## Was Absolventen tun können

segments.src: There is no guaranteed formula, but career counselors and labor experts commonly suggest several practical steps:
segments.tr: Es gibt kein garantiertes Erfolgsrezept, aber Karriereberater und Arbeitsmarktexperten empfehlen häufig mehrere praktische Schritte:

segments.src: 1. **Build demonstrable skills.** Internships, co-ops, freelance projects and portfolios give employers evidence beyond a transcript.
segments.tr: 1. **Nachweisbare Fähigkeiten aufbauen.** Praktika, Werksstudententätigkeiten, Freiberufler-Projekte und Portfolios liefern Arbeitgebern Beweise über das Zeugnis hinaus.

segments.src: 2. **Learn to work with AI tools.** Showing that you can use them well, check their output and catch their errors is increasingly seen as a baseline expectation.
segments.tr: 2. **Lernen, mit KI-Tools zu arbeiten.** Zu zeigen, dass man sie gut nutzen, ihre Ergebnisse überprüfen und ihre Fehler erkennen kann, wird zunehmend als Grunderwartung angesehen.

segments.src: 3. **Develop human-centered strengths.** Communication, collaboration, problem framing and persuasion remain hard to automate.
segments.tr: 3. **Menschzentrierte Stärken entwickeln.** Kommunikation, Zusammenarbeit, Problemstellung und Überzeugungskraft bleiben schwer zu automatisieren.

segments.src: 4. **Widen the search.** Smaller firms, public-sector roles, nonprofits and industries outside your major may be more open to beginners.
segments.tr: 4. **Die Suche ausweiten.** Kleinere Firmen, Stellen im öffentlichen Sektor, gemeinnützige Organisationen und Branchen außerhalb des eigenen Hauptfachs sind möglicherweise offener für Anfänger.

segments.src: 5. **Use your network.** Referrals still account for a meaningful share of hires, especially when applicant volumes are high.
segments.tr: 5. **Das eigene Netzwerk nutzen.** Empfehlungen machen nach wie vor einen bedeutenden Anteil der Einstellungen aus, insbesondere bei hohem Bewerberaufkommen.

segments.src: 6. **Stay flexible.** A first job rarely defines an entire career, and many people move across fields within a few years.
segments.tr: 6. **Flexibel bleiben.** Ein erster Job definiert selten eine ganze Karriere, und viele Menschen wechseln innerhalb weniger Jahre das Feld.

segments.src: ## What Policymakers and Schools Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Was Politik und Bildungseinrichtungen abwägen

segments.src: Universities are reviewing how well their programs match employer needs, and many are adding AI literacy to their curricula.
segments.tr: Universitäten überprüfen, wie gut ihre Programme zu den Bedürfnissen der Arbeitgeber passen, und viele nehmen KI-Kompetenz in ihre Lehrpläne auf.

segments.src: Policymakers and workforce groups are discussing support for apprenticeships, retraining programs and clearer labor-market data so students can make better-informed choices.
segments.tr: Politiker und Arbeitsmarktgruppen diskutieren über die Unterstützung von Ausbildungsprogrammen, Umschulungsmaßnahmen und klareren Arbeitsmarktdaten, damit Studierende fundiertere Entscheidungen treffen können.

segments.src: Whether those efforts will keep pace with the technology remains an open question.
segments.tr: Ob diese Bemühungen mit der Technologie Schritt halten können, bleibt eine offene Frage.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: The data points to a genuinely harder market for new graduates than they have seen in years, with AI changing how employers think about beginner roles.
segments.tr: Die Daten deuten auf einen deutlich schwierigeren Markt für Berufseinsteiger hin, als sie ihn seit Jahren erlebt haben, wobei KI die Art und Weise verändert, wie Arbeitgeber über Anfängerrollen denken.

segments.src: Yet the picture is still developing.
segments.tr: Dennoch entwickelt sich das Gesamtbild noch.

segments.src: Economists caution against drawing sweeping conclusions from a few years of numbers, and the hiring cycle could shift again.
segments.tr: Ökonomen warnen davor, aus den Zahlen weniger Jahre vorschnelle Schlüsse zu ziehen, und der Einstellungszyklus könnte sich wieder verschieben.

segments.src: For now, the most reliable advice is to build real-world experience, stay adaptable, and treat AI as a tool to master rather than only a threat.
segments.tr: Derzeit lautet der verlässlichste Rat, praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln, anpassungsfähig zu bleiben und KI als ein Werkzeug zu betrachten, das man beherrschen muss, anstatt nur als Bedrohung.

vi.title: Áp lực ở cấp độ đầu vào: Tại sao sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp đang gặp khó khăn trong việc tìm kiếm công việc đầu tiên khi các nhà tuyển dụng dựa vào AI

segments.src: For decades, a college degree worked like a dependable ticket into the workforce.
segments.tr: Trong nhiều thập kỷ, bằng đại học giống như một tấm vé đáng tin cậy để bước vào lực lượng lao động.

segments.src: Graduate in May, start a job by fall.
segments.tr: Tốt nghiệp vào tháng 5, bắt đầu công việc vào mùa thu.

segments.src: That pattern is looking less certain.
segments.tr: Mô hình đó đang trở nên ít chắc chắn hơn.

segments.src: Over the past couple of years, unemployment among recent college graduates has climbed above the overall national rate, a reversal of the long-standing norm in which degree holders fared better than the average worker.
segments.tr: Trong vài năm qua, tỷ lệ thất nghiệp ở những sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp đại học đã tăng cao hơn tỷ lệ chung của cả nước, một sự đảo ngược so với chuẩn mực lâu nay là những người có bằng cấp thường có kết quả tốt hơn so với người lao động trung bình.

segments.src: At the same time, employers are openly rethinking what a "junior" role should look like as artificial intelligence tools take over many routine tasks.
segments.tr: Đồng thời, các nhà tuyển dụng đang công khai suy nghĩ lại về việc một vai trò "cấp dưới" nên như thế nào khi các công cụ trí tuệ nhân tạo đảm nhận nhiều công việc thường ngày.

segments.src: This article walks through what the data suggests, which fields appear most exposed, and what it could mean for the next generation of workers.
segments.tr: Bài viết này đi sâu vào những gì dữ liệu gợi ý, những lĩnh vực nào có vẻ dễ bị ảnh hưởng nhất và điều đó có thể có ý nghĩa gì đối với thế hệ lao động tiếp theo.

segments.src: It is a general overview, not career or financial advice.
segments.tr: Đây là một cái nhìn tổng quan, không phải lời khuyên về nghề nghiệp hay tài chính.

segments.src: ## What the Numbers Show
segments.tr: ## Những con số cho thấy điều gì

segments.src: Federal Reserve Bank of New York research and U.S.
segments.tr: Nghiên cứu của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang New York và dữ liệu của Cục Thống kê Lao động Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics data have both pointed to the same trend: young, college-educated workers are having a harder time finding work than in the recent past.
segments.tr: đều chỉ ra cùng một xu hướng: những người lao động trẻ có trình độ đại học đang gặp khó khăn hơn trong việc tìm kiếm việc làm so với thời gian gần đây.

segments.src: In several recent readings, the unemployment rate for recent graduates (typically ages 22 to 27) has been higher than the rate for all workers.
segments.tr: Trong một vài báo cáo gần đây, tỷ lệ thất nghiệp đối với sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp (thường từ 22 đến 27 tuổi) đã cao hơn tỷ lệ đối với tất cả người lao động.

segments.src: Historically, that gap ran the other way.
segments.tr: Trong lịch sử, khoảng cách đó diễn ra theo chiều ngược lại.

segments.src: A few details are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Một vài chi tiết đáng lưu ý:

segments.src: - **The gap is relative, not catastrophic.** Most recent graduates do find work. But the time it takes, and the share who end up in jobs that do not require a degree, have both drawn attention.
segments.tr: - **Khoảng cách này là tương đối, không phải là thảm họa.** Hầu hết sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp đều tìm được việc làm. Nhưng thời gian tìm kiếm và tỷ lệ những người cuối cùng phải làm các công việc không yêu cầu bằng cấp đều đã thu hút sự chú ý.

segments.src: - **Underemployment matters too.** Many graduates take roles below their qualifications while they keep searching, which headline unemployment figures do not capture.
segments.tr: - **Tình trạng thiếu việc làm cũng rất quan trọng.** Nhiều sinh viên tốt nghiệp chấp nhận các vai trò thấp hơn trình độ của họ trong khi vẫn tiếp tục tìm kiếm, điều mà các số liệu thất nghiệp chính không nắm bắt được.

segments.src: - **Several forces overlap.** Higher interest rates, cautious corporate hiring, a large number of graduates, and post-pandemic adjustments have all played a part. AI is one factor among several, and economists disagree about how large its role is so far.
segments.tr: - **Nhiều lực lượng chồng chéo.** Lãi suất cao hơn, việc tuyển dụng thận trọng của doanh nghiệp, số lượng lớn sinh viên tốt nghiệp và các điều chỉnh sau đại dịch đều đóng một vai trò nhất định. AI là một yếu tố trong số nhiều yếu tố, và các nhà kinh tế không đồng ý về việc vai trò của nó lớn đến mức nào cho đến nay.

segments.src: ## Why Junior Roles Are Under Pressure
segments.tr: ## Tại sao các vai trò cấp dưới đang chịu áp lực

segments.src: Entry-level jobs have traditionally served two purposes: getting basic work done and training the next generation of experienced staff.
segments.tr: Các công việc cấp độ đầu vào theo truyền thống phục vụ hai mục đích: hoàn thành công việc cơ bản và đào tạo thế hệ nhân viên có kinh nghiệm tiếp theo.

segments.src: Much of that basic work consists of tasks such as drafting summaries, cleaning up data, writing first-pass code, researching background material, and preparing routine reports.
segments.tr: Phần lớn công việc cơ bản đó bao gồm các nhiệm vụ như soạn thảo tóm tắt, làm sạch dữ liệu, viết mã sơ bộ, nghiên cứu tài liệu nền và chuẩn bị các báo cáo thường quy.

segments.src: Those are the kinds of tasks that modern AI tools handle reasonably well.
segments.tr: Đó là những loại nhiệm vụ mà các công cụ AI hiện đại xử lý khá tốt.

segments.src: Some hiring managers say they can now accomplish with a smaller team, or with a few experienced people using AI assistants, what once required a larger group that included several new hires.
segments.tr: Một số nhà quản lý tuyển dụng cho biết họ hiện có thể hoàn thành công việc với một nhóm nhỏ hơn, hoặc với một vài người có kinh nghiệm sử dụng trợ lý AI, điều mà trước đây đòi hỏi một nhóm lớn hơn bao gồm nhiều nhân viên mới.

segments.src: Others say they are simply being more selective, hiring fewer juniors and expecting those they do hire to arrive with stronger practical skills.
segments.tr: Những người khác cho biết họ chỉ đơn giản là chọn lọc kỹ hơn, thuê ít nhân viên cấp dưới hơn và mong đợi những người họ thuê phải có kỹ năng thực tế mạnh mẽ hơn.

segments.src: There is a caveat.
segments.tr: Có một lưu ý.

segments.src: Surveys of employers show mixed intentions, and some companies say they are still hiring beginners, or even expanding programs for them.
segments.tr: Các cuộc khảo sát về nhà tuyển dụng cho thấy những ý định trái chiều, và một số công ty cho biết họ vẫn đang tuyển dụng người mới bắt đầu, hoặc thậm chí mở rộng các chương trình dành cho họ.

segments.src: It is also hard to separate AI-driven change from the ordinary hiring cycle, in which companies pull back when the economy looks uncertain.
segments.tr: Cũng khó để tách biệt sự thay đổi do AI thúc đẩy khỏi chu kỳ tuyển dụng thông thường, trong đó các công ty rút lui khi nền kinh tế có vẻ không chắc chắn.

segments.src: ## Which Fields Appear Hardest Hit
segments.tr: ## Những lĩnh vực nào có vẻ bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề nhất

segments.src: Researchers and labor analysts have noted that exposure varies widely by field.
segments.tr: Các nhà nghiên cứu và phân tích lao động đã lưu ý rằng mức độ ảnh hưởng thay đổi rất nhiều tùy theo lĩnh vực.

segments.src: - **Software and tech support.** Computer science graduates, once seen as nearly guaranteed a strong job market, have faced a tougher environment as companies trimmed headcount and AI coding assistants became common.
segments.tr: - **Phần mềm và hỗ trợ kỹ thuật.** Sinh viên tốt nghiệp ngành khoa học máy tính, từng được coi là gần như đảm bảo có một thị trường việc làm mạnh mẽ, đã phải đối mặt với môi trường khó khăn hơn khi các công ty cắt giảm nhân sự và các trợ lý lập trình AI trở nên phổ biến.

segments.src: - **Marketing, content and communications.** Entry-level writing, editing and basic design work are areas where generative tools are widely used.
segments.tr: - **Tiếp thị, nội dung và truyền thông.** Viết lách, biên tập và thiết kế cơ bản ở cấp độ đầu vào là những lĩnh vực mà các công cụ tạo sinh được sử dụng rộng rãi.

segments.src: - **Administrative and customer support roles.** Routine inquiries and scheduling are increasingly automated.
segments.tr: - **Các vai trò hành chính và hỗ trợ khách hàng.** Các yêu cầu thường quy và lập lịch trình ngày càng được tự động hóa.

segments.src: - **Finance and accounting support.** Data entry, reconciliation and first-pass analysis are being streamlined.
segments.tr: - **Hỗ trợ tài chính và kế toán.** Nhập dữ liệu, đối chiếu và phân tích sơ bộ đang được hợp lý hóa.

segments.src: - **Paralegal and research work.** Document review and summarization are common AI use cases.
segments.tr: - **Công việc trợ lý pháp lý và nghiên cứu.** Xem xét tài liệu và tóm tắt là những trường hợp sử dụng AI phổ biến.

segments.src: By contrast, fields that rely on hands-on, in-person or credential-gated work, such as nursing and other healthcare roles, skilled trades, and education, have generally seen steadier demand.
segments.tr: Ngược lại, các lĩnh vực dựa vào công việc thực hành, trực tiếp hoặc yêu cầu bằng cấp, chẳng hạn như điều dưỡng và các vai trò chăm sóc sức khỏe khác, các ngành nghề có tay nghề cao và giáo dục, nhìn chung có nhu cầu ổn định hơn.

segments.src: That does not mean they are risk-free, but the pressure looks different.
segments.tr: Điều đó không có nghĩa là chúng không có rủi ro, nhưng áp lực trông có vẻ khác.

segments.src: ## The Longer-Term Worry: A Broken Ladder
segments.tr: ## Nỗi lo dài hạn: Một chiếc thang bị gãy

segments.src: The biggest concern among economists is not only whether this year's graduates find jobs.
segments.tr: Mối quan tâm lớn nhất của các nhà kinh tế không chỉ là liệu sinh viên tốt nghiệp năm nay có tìm được việc làm hay không.

segments.src: It is what happens if fewer entry-level positions exist over several years.
segments.tr: Đó là điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu ít vị trí cấp độ đầu vào tồn tại trong vài năm.

segments.src: Experienced professionals are developed by doing junior work first.
segments.tr: Các chuyên gia có kinh nghiệm được phát triển bằng cách thực hiện công việc cấp dưới trước.

segments.src: If that rung of the ladder shrinks, companies may face a shortage of mid-level talent later on, and workers may find it harder to build the experience that employers want.
segments.tr: Nếu nấc thang đó bị thu hẹp, các công ty có thể phải đối mặt với tình trạng thiếu hụt nhân tài cấp trung sau này, và người lao động có thể thấy khó khăn hơn trong việc xây dựng kinh nghiệm mà các nhà tuyển dụng mong muốn.

segments.src: Some employers are already experimenting with responses, such as apprenticeships, rotational programs, and redesigned junior roles that focus on judgment, client contact and supervising AI output rather than producing every first draft by hand.
segments.tr: Một số nhà tuyển dụng đã thử nghiệm các phản ứng, chẳng hạn như học nghề, các chương trình luân chuyển và các vai trò cấp dưới được thiết kế lại tập trung vào khả năng phán đoán, liên hệ khách hàng và giám sát đầu ra của AI thay vì tạo ra mọi bản thảo đầu tiên bằng tay.

segments.src: ## What Graduates Can Do
segments.tr: ## Sinh viên tốt nghiệp có thể làm gì

segments.src: There is no guaranteed formula, but career counselors and labor experts commonly suggest several practical steps:
segments.tr: Không có công thức đảm bảo nào, nhưng các cố vấn nghề nghiệp và chuyên gia lao động thường gợi ý một số bước thực tế:

segments.src: 1. **Build demonstrable skills.** Internships, co-ops, freelance projects and portfolios give employers evidence beyond a transcript.
segments.tr: 1. **Xây dựng các kỹ năng có thể chứng minh được.** Thực tập, chương trình hợp tác, dự án tự do và danh mục đầu tư cung cấp cho nhà tuyển dụng bằng chứng ngoài bảng điểm.

segments.src: 2. **Learn to work with AI tools.** Showing that you can use them well, check their output and catch their errors is increasingly seen as a baseline expectation.
segments.tr: 2. **Học cách làm việc với các công cụ AI.** Cho thấy rằng bạn có thể sử dụng chúng tốt, kiểm tra đầu ra của chúng và phát hiện lỗi của chúng ngày càng được coi là một kỳ vọng cơ bản.

segments.src: 3. **Develop human-centered strengths.** Communication, collaboration, problem framing and persuasion remain hard to automate.
segments.tr: 3. **Phát triển các thế mạnh lấy con người làm trung tâm.** Giao tiếp, hợp tác, định hình vấn đề và thuyết phục vẫn khó có thể tự động hóa.

segments.src: 4. **Widen the search.** Smaller firms, public-sector roles, nonprofits and industries outside your major may be more open to beginners.
segments.tr: 4. **Mở rộng tìm kiếm.** Các công ty nhỏ hơn, các vai trò trong khu vực công, các tổ chức phi lợi nhuận và các ngành công nghiệp bên ngoài chuyên ngành của bạn có thể cởi mở hơn với người mới bắt đầu.

segments.src: 5. **Use your network.** Referrals still account for a meaningful share of hires, especially when applicant volumes are high.
segments.tr: 5. **Sử dụng mạng lưới của bạn.** Giới thiệu vẫn chiếm một phần đáng kể trong việc tuyển dụng, đặc biệt là khi số lượng ứng viên cao.

segments.src: 6. **Stay flexible.** A first job rarely defines an entire career, and many people move across fields within a few years.
segments.tr: 6. **Luôn linh hoạt.** Công việc đầu tiên hiếm khi xác định toàn bộ sự nghiệp, và nhiều người chuyển đổi lĩnh vực trong vòng vài năm.

segments.src: ## What Policymakers and Schools Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Các nhà hoạch định chính sách và trường học đang cân nhắc điều gì

segments.src: Universities are reviewing how well their programs match employer needs, and many are adding AI literacy to their curricula.
segments.tr: Các trường đại học đang xem xét mức độ phù hợp của các chương trình của họ với nhu cầu của nhà tuyển dụng, và nhiều trường đang bổ sung kiến thức về AI vào chương trình giảng dạy của họ.

segments.src: Policymakers and workforce groups are discussing support for apprenticeships, retraining programs and clearer labor-market data so students can make better-informed choices.
segments.tr: Các nhà hoạch định chính sách và các nhóm lực lượng lao động đang thảo luận về việc hỗ trợ học nghề, các chương trình đào tạo lại và dữ liệu thị trường lao động rõ ràng hơn để sinh viên có thể đưa ra những lựa chọn sáng suốt hơn.

segments.src: Whether those efforts will keep pace with the technology remains an open question.
segments.tr: Liệu những nỗ lực đó có theo kịp công nghệ hay không vẫn là một câu hỏi mở.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The data points to a genuinely harder market for new graduates than they have seen in years, with AI changing how employers think about beginner roles.
segments.tr: Dữ liệu chỉ ra một thị trường thực sự khó khăn hơn đối với sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp so với những gì họ từng thấy trong nhiều năm, với việc AI thay đổi cách các nhà tuyển dụng suy nghĩ về các vai trò cho người mới bắt đầu.

segments.src: Yet the picture is still developing.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, bức tranh vẫn đang phát triển.

segments.src: Economists caution against drawing sweeping conclusions from a few years of numbers, and the hiring cycle could shift again.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế cảnh báo không nên rút ra những kết luận bao quát từ vài năm số liệu, và chu kỳ tuyển dụng có thể thay đổi trở lại.

segments.src: For now, the most reliable advice is to build real-world experience, stay adaptable, and treat AI as a tool to master rather than only a threat.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, lời khuyên đáng tin cậy nhất là xây dựng kinh nghiệm thực tế, luôn thích nghi và coi AI là một công cụ để làm chủ thay vì chỉ là một mối đe dọa.
